steps.note: The raw milk is sieved, covered and left to sour on its own flora until it thickens, which takes a day or two longer in the cold months.

links.name: Moonga et al. (2019), The art of mabisi production: a traditional fermented milk, PLoS One

sources.text: Wikipedia for milk soured by its indigenous bacteria without a starter; the figures are from a survey of mabisi makers in Zambia, one traditional spontaneously soured raw milk, and are not meant for all of them.
